5 independent source channels address signals to this ground: atlanta-rezoning-cases, fdic-locations, fdic-sod, nps-national-register, osm-notes.

3 permit or rezoning records address to this ground. They record authorized or proposed change, not proof that construction or land-use change occurred. At least one polygon is indexed by a representative address; its preserved geometry may span other cells.
FDIC Summary of Deposits reports $425,227,000 held across 3 branches addressed to this ground. This is reported deposit stock, not evidence that the money is invested locally.

5 officially recorded historic or commemorative resources address to this ground. This measures institutionalized memory in the connected registers, not everything a community considers historically important.
